improvement_relation.interpretation: The Environment projection now keeps the observed partial binding-ID capture status and source event identity available after per-binding rows are compacted. Agent receipt, discoverability, understanding, and use remain unmeasured.
Longer-term effectiveness requires independent subsequent session activity.
